description: This file defines the WKPage class and related components for managing a WebKit page within the Playwright testing framework, including session initialization, event handling, navigation, and DOM interactions.

classes.name: WKPage
classes.description: Represents a WebKit page, managing sessions, navigation, event handling, and DOM interactions within Playwright.

classes.name: WKFrame
classes.description: Represents a frame within a WKPage, handling console messages and initialization.

methods.name: _initializePageProxySession
methods.description: Initializes the page proxy session with necessary settings and permissions.

methods.name: _setSession
methods.description: Sets the current WKSession and updates event listeners.

methods.name: _initializeSession
methods.description: Initializes a session, handling provisional sessions and resource tree.

methods.name: _initializeSessionMayThrow
methods.description: Performs session initialization, enabling agents and setting emulation options.

methods.name: _onTargetCreated
methods.description: Handles creation of new targets, including frames and pages.

methods.name: _onTargetDestroyed
methods.description: Handles target destruction, cleaning up sessions and frames.

methods.name: navigateFrame
methods.description: Navigates a specific frame to a given URL.

methods.name: _onConsoleMessage
methods.description: Processes console messages from the page, including errors and logs.

methods.name: _onConsoleRepeatCountUpdated
methods.description: Updates console message repeat counts for batching.

methods.name: _onDialog
methods.description: Handles JavaScript dialogs (alert, confirm, prompt).

methods.name: _onFileChooserOpened
methods.description: Handles file chooser dialogs.

methods.name: _setEmulateMedia
methods.description: Sets media emulation parameters like color scheme and prefers-contrast.

methods.name: updateExtraHTTPHeaders
methods.description: Updates extra HTTP headers for the page.

methods.name: _calculateExtraHTTPHeaders
methods.description: Calculates combined extra HTTP headers from context and page options.

methods.name: updateEmulateMedia
methods.description: Updates media emulation settings.

methods.name: updateEmulatedViewportSize
methods.description: Updates the viewport size based on emulation settings.

methods.name: updateUserAgent
methods.description: Overrides the user agent string.

methods.name: bringToFront
methods.description: Brings the page to the foreground.

methods.name: _updateViewport
methods.description: Applies viewport and device metrics overrides.

methods.name: updateRequestInterception
methods.description: Enables or disables request interception.

methods.name: updateOffline
methods.description: Sets offline mode.

methods.name: updateHttpCredentials
methods.description: Sets HTTP authentication credentials.

methods.name: updateFileChooserInterception
methods.description: Enables or disables file chooser dialog interception.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads the page.

methods.name: goBack
methods.description: Navigates back in history.

methods.name: goForward
methods.description: Navigates forward in history.

methods.name: requestGC
methods.description: Triggers garbage collection.

methods.name: addInitScript
methods.description: Adds an initialization script to the page.

methods.name: removeInitScripts
methods.description: Removes specified initialization scripts.

methods.name: exposePlaywrightBinding
methods.description: Exposes Playwright's binding to the page.

methods.name: _calculateBootstrapScript
methods.description: Generates the bootstrap script source code.

methods.name: _publicKeyCredentialScript
methods.description: Provides a polyfill for PublicKeyCredential API.

methods.name: _updateBootstrapScript
methods.description: Updates the bootstrap script in the page.

methods.name: closePage
methods.description: Closes the page, optionally running beforeUnload.

methods.name: setBackgroundColor
methods.description: Overrides the default background color.

methods.name: takeScreenshot
methods.description: Captures a screenshot of the page or a region.

methods.name: getContentFrame
methods.description: Gets the frame associated with a DOM element.

methods.name: getOwnerFrame
methods.description: Gets the owner frame ID of a DOM element.

methods.name: getBoundingBox
methods.description: Calculates the bounding box of a DOM element.

methods.name: scrollRectIntoViewIfNeeded
methods.description: Scrolls a DOM element into view if needed.

methods.name: startScreencast
methods.description: Starts screencast recording.

methods.name: stopScreencast
methods.description: Stops screencast recording.

methods.name: _onScreencastFrame
methods.description: Handles incoming screencast frames.

methods.name: rafCountForStablePosition
methods.description: Returns the number of requestAnimationFrame calls needed for stable position.

methods.name: getContentQuads
methods.description: Retrieves content quads for a DOM element.

methods.name: setInputFilePaths
methods.description: Sets file input element paths.

methods.name: adoptElementHandle
methods.description: Adopts a DOM element handle into a different context.

methods.name: getFrameElement
methods.description: Gets the DOM element corresponding to a frame.

methods.name: _maybeCancelCoopNavigationRequest
methods.description: Cancels cooperative navigation requests if needed.

methods.name: _adoptRequestFromNewProcess
methods.description: Adopts a network request from a new process/session.

methods.name: _onRequestWillBeSent
methods.description: Handles network request initiation.

methods.name: _onRequest
methods.description: Processes network request events, including redirects.

methods.name: _handleRequestRedirect
methods.description: Handles network request redirects.

methods.name: _onRequestIntercepted
methods.description: Handles intercepted network requests.

methods.name: _onResponseReceived
methods.description: Processes network responses.

methods.name: _onLoadingFinished
methods.description: Handles completion of network requests.

methods.name: _onLoadingFailed
methods.description: Handles network request failures.

methods.name: _grantPermissions
methods.description: Grants permissions for a given origin.

methods.name: _clearPermissions
methods.description: Resets permissions.
